findings.text: Often what you're experiencing is a very charming guard.
findings.what: A guard that shows up as numbness, cynicism or sleepiness is not charming; the sentence says it is a common thing, so 'charming' looks like a slip for 'common'.
findings.fix: Often what you're experiencing is a very common guard.

findings.text: Their trust can question your promises, remember when you failed to protect them, and take its time.
findings.what: Trust does not question or remember; the subject should be the little one (they), so 'Their trust' and 'its' do not make sense.
findings.fix: They can question your promises, remember when you failed to protect them, and take their time.

findings.text: before taking off the kid gloves, so to speak, and jumping into the healing work
findings.what: 'Taking off the kid gloves' means becoming harsh, which is the opposite of the gentle quality time the sentence recommends.
findings.fix: before jumping into the healing work

notes: Block 100 'try it out instead of repeating the exercise' reads slightly odd but is understandable, so I left it. The rest of blocks 88 to 167 reads sensibly.
